name: Publish Connectors Prerelease Command
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  check-comment:
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      pr-number: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.pr-number }}
      comment-id: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.comment-id }}
    steps:
      - name: Extract PR number and comment ID
        id: extract
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER="${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
          echo "pr-number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "comment-id=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  publish-prerelease:
    needs: check-comment
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Get modified connectors
        id: get_modified
        run: |
          MODIFIED_CONNECTORS=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep "^airbyte-connectors/" | sed 's|^airbyte-connectors/||' | cut -d'/' -f1 | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
          echo "modified-connectors=$MODIFIED_CONNECTORS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post start comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const prNumber = `${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}`;
            const sha = process.env.GITHUB_SHA.substring(0, 10);
            const comment = `🚀 Starting pre-release publish for modified connectors...\n\nExpected image tags will follow the pattern: \`${sha}\`\n\nThis may take several minutes.`;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: parseInt(prNumber),
              body: comment
            });

      - name: Publish connectors prerelease
        if: steps.get_modified.outputs.modified-connectors != ''
        uses: ./.github/workflows/publish_connectors.yml
        with:
          release-type: pre-release
          modified: true
          connectors: ${{ steps.get_modified.outputs.modified-connectors }}

      - name: Post completion comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const prNumber = `${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}`;
            const sha = process.env.GITHUB_SHA.substring(0, 10);
            const success = !!(process.env.STEP_SUCCESS === 'true');
            const comment = success 
              ? `✅ Pre-release publish completed successfully!\n\nImage tags will be available at: \`${sha}\``
              : `❌ Pre-release publish failed. Please check the workflow logs for details.`;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: parseInt(prNumber),
              body: comment
            });
